svg.aria-label: The cover of GPU Architecture & Parallel Programming from First Principles. Inside a glowing hive, the queen bee, wearing a crown and holding a sceptre, gives one order to the whole colony: c[i] = a[i] + b[i]. Below her, 32 worker bees in hard hats stand in 4 rows of 8, one warp, each in front of its own honeycomb cell and each filling it with honey at the same moment. One worker in the third row has wandered off on a branch of its own, with a question mark over its head. A crab in a hard hat waves from the corner, because the second half of the book writes kernels in Rust.
